description: Measured on develop e515ae314 (AOT), File.stream! |> Stream.map(&JSON.decode!/1) |> Enum.to_list over prefixes of a compile log with constant bytes per line (415): new allocation per line is about 0.52 MB at 4,000 lines, 0.75 MB at 8,000 and 0.98 MB at 16,000. The read-only probe grows too (107, 175, 267 B per line). Cause unknown. First step: find what grows (block capacity counted as allocation, or a real per-line cost that depends on the heap). Probes: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz-xxd13-build/d6960461-b7a2-4585-a9e7-9f2477e57ee2/scratchpad/slow (dec.fz, read.fz, m.py).
title: Decoding a line costs the same however many lines came before
